silent.label: Silent
silent.description: Received campaigns but opened none of them.

lapsed.label: Lapsed
lapsed.description: Customers with no opens or messages for a long time.

hot_chat.label: Hot in chat
hot_chat.description: Contacts whose latest chat reading says they are ready to buy.

high_propensity.label: Likely to convert
high_propensity.description: The top tenth by the conversion model.

service_due.label: Service due
service_due.description: Contacts whose service date is due.

campaigns.title: Campaign replies
campaigns.hint: Contacts who wrote back within 24 and 72 hours of a send, counted from the inbox.

sendTimes.title: Best time to send
sendTimes.hint: When your contacts read campaigns and write to you, in your workspace time zone.
sendTimes.empty: Not enough activity yet to say.
sendTimes.chart: Activity by hour of the day
sendTimes.sample: Based on {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}.

propensity.title: Conversion model
propensity.hint: Learns from the contacts who became customers which behaviour goes with converting, and scores everyone.
propensity.failed: The model couldn’t be updated. Try again.
propensity.trained: The model has learned from your converted contacts.
propensity.notTrained: Too few converted contacts to learn from yet, so fixed weights are used.

quality.title: How well it is working
quality.hint: Whether the suggestions are used, how well the lead score separates the contacts who converted, and what the AI cost, over the last 30 days.

enrichment.title: Company details
enrichment.hint: Looks up company details for contacts with a business email address and shows them on the contact.
enrichment.asked: {count, plural, one {# contact looked up} other {# contacts looked up}}.

autoStage.title: Automatic stage changes
autoStage.hint: Only readings the AI is very sure about, up to a daily limit. Each can be put back as long as nobody moved the contact since.
autoStage.empty: Nothing has been changed automatically yet.
autoStage.undoDone: The contact is back where it was.
autoStage.undoRefused: This change can’t be undone any more: the contact moved on.
autoStage.undoFailed: The change couldn’t be undone. Try again.

assistant.title: Broadcast assistant
assistant.hint: Say what you want to achieve. It suggests one of your audiences and one of your approved templates, weighing the replies each template really got. It sends and creates nothing.
assistant.goal: What do you want to achieve?
assistant.goalHint: For example: remind everyone who registered about Saturday’s event.
assistant.placeholder: Remind registered contacts about the event on Saturday
assistant.considered: Chosen from {audiences, plural, one {# audience} other {# audiences}} and {templates, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}}.

controls.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.

audiences.title: Audiences and stages
audiences.hint: Work out who to talk to, and suggest stage changes from what contacts do with campaigns.

chats.title: Reading chats
chats.hint: Uses the chat reading of AI lead scoring, so it needs that to be on. Personal data is partly masked before a chat is read.

assist.title: Assistants
assist.hint: Help with decisions. Nothing is sent to a contact.

campaign_response.label: Real campaign replies
campaign_response.hint: Count the contacts who wrote back after a campaign and fix the response numbers.

send_times.label: Best time to send
send_times.hint: Show the hours when your contacts read and write.

propensity.label: Conversion model
propensity.hint: Score every contact on how likely they are to convert.

quality.label: Quality dashboard
quality.hint: Show how often suggestions are used and what the AI costs.

daily_digest.label: Daily summary
daily_digest.hint: A short summary of the workspace at the top of this screen.

engagement_audiences.label: Engagement audiences
engagement_audiences.hint: Engaged, silent and lapsed contacts, ready to send campaigns to.

engagement_stage_rules.label: Stage suggestions from campaigns
engagement_stage_rules.hint: Suggest moving a contact on when they keep opening campaigns.

service_rules.label: Service reminders and follow-ups
service_rules.hint: Find contacts whose service or purchase date makes them due, using your own rules.

enrichment.label: Company details
enrichment.hint: Look up company details for contacts with a business email address.

intent_fields.label: Chat intent on the contact
intent_fields.hint: Write what the chat is about to the “AI intent” property, so a flow can react to it.

language_detect.label: Chat language
language_detect.hint: Note which language each chat is in.

auto_notes.label: Chat summary notes
auto_notes.hint: Add a short summary of the chat to the contact as a note.

hot_lead_alerts.label: Hot lead alerts
hot_lead_alerts.hint: Raise an alert and notify the owner when a contact is clearly ready to buy.

unanswered_watch.label: Unanswered buying questions
unanswered_watch.hint: Flag buying or price questions that nobody answered.

handover_summary.label: Summary on handover
handover_summary.hint: When a chat is handed to a person, put a summary of it at the top.

purchase_routing.label: Route buyers to a person
purchase_routing.hint: Suggest who should take a chat when the contact wants to buy.

registration_check.label: Registration problems
registration_check.hint: Flag contacts who say they paid or registered but got no confirmation.

status_reply.label: Order and repair status
status_reply.hint: Prepare the status of an order or repair when a customer asks about it.

optout_detection.label: Opt-out requests
optout_detection.hint: Flag contacts who ask to stop; accepting records it in the consent ledger.

broadcast_assistant.label: Broadcast assistant
broadcast_assistant.hint: Suggest an audience and a template for a goal.

auto_stage.label: Automatic stage changes
auto_stage.hint: Move a contact on when the AI is very sure, up to a daily limit, with undo.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.hint: The numbers the parts above use.
thresholds.hotLeadConfidenceHint: How sure the reading must be, from 0.5 to 1.
thresholds.unansweredHours: Hours before a question counts as unanswered
thresholds.lapsedDays: Days before a customer counts as lapsed
thresholds.engagedOpens: Campaigns opened to count as engaged
thresholds.stageMinOpens: Campaigns opened to suggest a stage change
thresholds.stageWindowDays: Days to look back for that
thresholds.autoDailyCapHint: The limit for the whole workspace.
thresholds.requireGroup: Only suggest a stage change for contacts that are in a group

rules.title: Your own rules and words
rules.statusFieldsHint: Contact properties that hold an order or repair status, such as repair_status.
rules.serviceRulesHint: Label | date property | days after | days until (optional).
rules.extraMaskTermsHint: A brand, an address or a name that must never be sent to the AI.

confirmEnrich.title: Look up company details?
confirmEnrich.body: To find company details, the business email address of a contact is sent to the lookup service. Personal email addresses are not sent.
